oneOf.description:
Replacement capability ceiling. The edit form always sends the full
object, so `None` clears any prior config back to the all-prompt default.

allow_file_browse.description: Allow file browsing (list files and inspect metadata via signaling)

allow_system_audio_capture.description: Allow capture and transmission of the host's system audio

approval_timeout.description:
Timeout for security approval requests in seconds.
`Some(0)` means "never time out"; `None` on the wire is normalized to the
30s default rather than treated as "never".
